newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank leads Estonia shares to new high.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank leads Estonia shares to new high.

text.p: The bourse index reached yet another new high on Tuesday, with strong buying pressure in Hansapank shares both in Tallinn and Helsinki.
"It was most likey the biggest trading day for Hansapank this year, at least one of the top days," one dealer said.
On the free list, privatisation securities led with turnover of 20.4 million kroons.
Total trade on the main list was 60.7 million kroons with the Talse index 3.80 percent higher at 297.72.
"This Talse increase would be one of the biggest rises for the Talse this year," another trader said.
Hansapank led the day again to rise by 9.15 kroons to close at 166.40 kroons on trade of 19.4 million kroons.
Hansapank in Helsinki also reached a new high, closing up two markka at 62.00 markka on healthly volume of 5.1 million markka.
"Helsinki pulled Hansa higher during the day's trade," one trader said.
"It is hard to say what was driving the interest in Helsinki, the run started yesterday following the rise on Hansapank in Tallinn, but there was just solid demand for the stock today," he added.
Forekspank was active with good two-way trade involved, holding its price stable for most of the day.
It ended down slightly with a fall of 0.15 kroons at 198.35 kroons on trade of 21.2 million kroons.
On the free market, privatisation securities dominated with 20.4 million kroons traded. They again closed higher on 0.385 kroons compared to 0.355 kroons on Monday.
Demand has been high as investors anticipate the sale of stakes in Eesti Gaas and Hotel Olympia for privatisation securities.
